serverbrowser.help.title: §6==== [ServerBrowser Commands] ====
serverbrowser.help.create: §e/browser create [width] [height] §7- Create display and get Remote Wand
serverbrowser.help.destroy: §e/browser destroy §7- Destroy display and wand held in hand
serverbrowser.help.home: §e/browser home §7- Return to default home page (alias: /bhome)
serverbrowser.help.open: §e/browser open <url/query> §7- Open web page or search query
serverbrowser.help.history: §e/browser back | forward §7- Navigate back / forward in browser history
serverbrowser.help.type: §e/browser type <text> §7- Type text into focused input box
serverbrowser.help.backspace: §e/browser backspace [count] §7- Delete characters in focused input (alias: /browser bs)
serverbrowser.help.enter: §e/browser enter §7- Press Enter key to submit form/search
serverbrowser.help.doubleclick: §e/browser click | rclick | dclick §7- Mouse click (left / right / double)
serverbrowser.help.wand: §e/browser wand §7- Reacquire Remote Wand for closest display within 10 blocks
serverbrowser.help.list: §e/browser list §7- View all active displays and their properties
serverbrowser.help.info: §e/browser info §7- View properties of held display (alias: /browser status)
serverbrowser.help.fps: §e/browser fps <FPS> §7- Change FPS for held display (e.g. 10, 14, 20, 30)
serverbrowser.help.quality: §e/browser quality <quality> §7- Change JPEG quality for held display (10-100) (alias: /browser qual)
serverbrowser.help.res: §e/browser res <scale> §7- Change resolution scale for held display (0.5=low, 1.0=normal, 2.0=crisp)
serverbrowser.help.destroy_near: §c/browser destroy_near §7- Force remove nearest display without wand
serverbrowser.help.destroy_id: §c/browser destroy_id <id> §7- Force remove display by ID
serverbrowser.help.wand_id: §c/browser wand_id <id> §7- Obtain Remote Wand for display by ID
serverbrowser.help.info_id: §c/browser info_id <id> §7- View properties of display by ID
serverbrowser.help.fps_id: §c/browser fps_id <id> <FPS> §7- Change FPS for display by ID
serverbrowser.help.quality_id: §c/browser quality_id <id> <quality> §7- Change JPEG quality for display by ID
serverbrowser.help.res_id: §c/browser res_id <id> <scale> §7- Change resolution scale for display by ID
serverbrowser.help.max_fps: §c/browser max_fps <FPS> §7- Set server-wide maximum FPS limit (1-60)
serverbrowser.help.max_quality: §c/browser max_quality <quality> §7- Set server-wide maximum JPEG quality limit (10-100)
serverbrowser.help.max_res: §c/browser max_res <scale> §7- Set server-wide maximum resolution scale limit (0.01+)
serverbrowser.help.reset: §c/browser reset §7- Remove all displays and reset counter to #1
serverbrowser.help.controls_left: §f- Left Click (Ranged / Swing in air): Scroll Up ▲
